title: Brawl2 — Distinct by design

heroes.name: Marcus Ironheart
heroes.traitText: Start with 0 Formation; hold up to 3. After an enemy attack spends any of your Block, gain 1 Formation if you survive. On your attacking reaction, spend 1 to move up to 1 toward the rival (once per attack), or spend 3 for +2 damage and an on-hit push up to 2 (once per attack). Misses and Loot do not earn Formation.

ultimate.name: Walking Wall
ultimate.text: After playing a non-Loot card Reaction while defending, move up to 1 toward the rival. Token actions do not trigger this.

heroes.weakness: Formation comes from Block actually spent against an attack. Piercing attacks and misses do not generate it.
heroes.combo: Every card can keep me standing.

heroes.name: Sibu Stormspear
heroes.traitText: Start with 3 ready War Spears. At attack activation, before movement, commit at most 1 for +2 damage. It is spent even on a miss. After a damaging non-Fury Hero attack without a committed spear, recover 1 spent spear.

ultimate.name: Stormhead
ultimate.text: Your spear-boosted attacks ignore 2 additional Block. Attacks without a committed spear do not gain this bonus.

heroes.weakness: A committed spear is spent even on a miss. Recover one only with a damaging non-Fury Hero attack that used no spear.

heroes.name: Vera Vendetta
heroes.traitText: Start with 1 ready Technique; hold up to 3. After your attack deals Health damage, ready 1. On your attacking reaction, spend 1 to play your active Dual card’s Reaction half without discarding it. Once per attack; normal restrictions and costs apply.

ultimate.name: Twin Blades
ultimate.text: After using a Technique to play your active card’s Reaction, you may move up to 1 before your opponent responds.

heroes.weakness: Techniques only reuse your active Dual attack’s Reaction half. Its timing, costs and once-per-attack limit still apply.
heroes.combo: I have an answer—and a sharp follow-up.

heroes.name: Mei Windwalker
heroes.traitText: After a non-Fury Hero attack, you may place a Wind within 2 spaces of yourself. Three markers maximum; relocate one when all are placed. One of your markers per space. When starting a voluntary move on your Wind, you may consume it to add 2 to that movement. Wind never grants a move by itself.

ultimate.name: Walk on Air
ultimate.text: For each non-Fury Hero attack, you may place or relocate its Wind at activation before printed movement, instead of after the attack. Only one placement per attack.

heroes.weakness: Wind extends a move that starts on its space; it never grants a free move. Several attacks cannot hit adjacent rivals.
heroes.combo: Your strike finds empty air. Mine reaches you.

heroes.name: Lord Smasherton
heroes.traitText: Start with 2 Impact; hold up to 3. After your attack deals Health damage, gain 1. On an attack wall slam, spend 1 for +2 wall damage, once per attack. Or, on your attacking reaction, spend 3 for +2 damage and on-hit push up to 3; no Impact wall bonus on that attack.

ultimate.name: You're Not Going Anywhere
ultimate.text: After your attack deals Health damage, pin the rival: they cannot move voluntarily until their next attack finishes. Pushes and pulls still work.

heroes.weakness: Slow, short-range attacks need movement or pulls. Impact must be saved for a wall slam or spent on Launch.
heroes.combo: Force the rival toward a wall, then choose when to spend Impact.

heroes.name: Alf Featherbottom
heroes.traitText: Start with 1 Aim; hold up to 2. After your attack deals Health damage at Range 3 or more, gain 1. Once per attack, on your attacking reaction, spend 1 for +2 maximum Range OR spend 2 to ignore 3 Block.

ultimate.name: Emergency Spring Boots
ultimate.text: When your attack activates, you may move 1 space before its printed movement. The rival then reacts normally.

heroes.weakness: Several attacks cannot hit adjacent rivals. Aim extends maximum Range; it does not lower minimum Range.
heroes.combo: Prepare a clear shot and preserve an escape.

heroes.name: Dr. Shealer
heroes.traitText: Start with 2 Research; hold up to 3. After paying Health for a card, gain 1 Research. You may immediately spend 1 to draw 1 card. Or, on a reaction turn, spend 2 to heal 3. Paying Research never earns Research.

ultimate.name: Malpractical Flight
ultimate.text: Your attacks gain +1 maximum Range. Your arena position, minimum Range and enemy attacks are unchanged.

heroes.weakness: Health payments can unlock Fury and Last Stand, but leave you easier to finish. Research spent on healing cannot also pay for cards or power Blood Bolt.
heroes.combo: Spend Health to create an opening; choose whether Research buys cards or recovery.

heroes.name: Helga Stonewall
heroes.traitText: Start with 3 Armour; hold up to 3. Once per enemy attack, use a defending reaction to break 1 for 2 Block OR break 2 for 3 Block and resist pushes/pulls for this attack. After your first damaging non-Fury Hero attack each round, repair 1.

ultimate.name: Hit Me. I Dare You.
ultimate.text: After an enemy attack connects in range, reflect 1 damage, even if fully blocked. Once per attack; ignores Block. Misses and Loot do not trigger it. Resolve reflection before checking victory; simultaneous knockouts draw.

heroes.weakness: Unused Block clears after every attack. Armour repairs only after your first damaging non-Fury Hero attack each round.
heroes.combo: Break Armour to survive, then land a Hero attack to repair it.

heroes.name: Raven Madison
heroes.traitText: Start with 1 Trick; hold up to 2. The first time you cross the rival during each active attack, gain 1. Token movement and all swaps never earn Tricks. On a reaction turn, spend 1 to move up to 1 or cross an adjacent rival (once per attack). On your attacking reaction, spend 2 for +2 damage (once per attack).

ultimate.name: My Shadow Has Other Plans
ultimate.text: Place your shadow on your space. Once per round, as your reaction, swap places with it. It stays on your old space. It cannot be attacked and does not block spaces. No swap onto the rival or while pinned. Refresh each round.

heroes.weakness: Crossing needs an empty landing space. Token movement and shadow swaps do not generate Tricks.
heroes.combo: Cross the rival to earn Tricks, then slip away or strike harder.

heroes.name: Friar Franc
heroes.traitText: Start with 1 Profit; hold up to 3. After a Basic attack deals Health damage, gain 1 Profit; you may immediately cash 1 for 1 Coin, even if already at 3 Profit. Once on your shopping turn, spend 2 Profit to buy one face-up Loot before your normal Coin purchase. You may replace one offer first. You may then make your normal Coin purchase; hold at most 2 Loot.

ultimate.name: The Emergency Stash
ultimate.text: Draw 1 free Loot on activation; at two Loot, you may replace one before drawing. Once per active attack, as your reaction, buy Loot for 1 Coin, holding at most two. Your opponent responds before you can play it.

heroes.weakness: Profit needs damaging Basic attacks. Spending Coins on card effects leaves fewer for Loot; you can hold only two Loot.
heroes.combo: Land Basic attacks to fund your next market play.

rules: Build your fight
Choose any 24 cards from your Hero’s 40-card pool: 20 designs, two copies each. No point budget or Basic/Hero quotas. Choose one of three Fury cards; keep it outside the deck.
Start
20 Health, 0 Coins. Start on spaces 3 and 6; random Edge. Shuffle your deck and draw 7.
Commit
Secretly choose two Attack-capable cards in order. A Dual card uses one half only. If you have fewer than two Attacks, commit those you have; missing slots pass.
Reveal & speed

Flip the first pair. Apply printed adjacent speed reductions. Reveal payments are optional, offered in Edge order. Then lock attack order: higher Speed first; Edge wins ties. Movement cannot change that order.
Activate & react

Resolve printed preparation and movement. Then the defender reacts first. Alternate one card Reaction, Loot, token action or pass. Playing a card or token action resets passes; two consecutive passes resolve the strike at the current distance. Draw only when a card or passive says so.
Movement

Move up to the printed distance, in either direction. You may stay, move partly or cross the rival, but never share a space or leave the eight-space arena. Choose when the effect resolves. Push and pull also allow zero or partial movement.
Scry & preparation

Scry: privately look at the top cards, choose their order on top, and put unselected cards underneath. No draw. Alf’s preparation then publicly reveals and bottoms the top card: Attack-capable gives +2 damage and ignores 2 Block; otherwise minimum Range becomes 1 and maximum Range gains 2.
Payments & discards

Printed reaction costs are paid before effects. Discard another means a different uncommitted hand card. An opponent forced to discard chooses their own card. Optional pre-reaction Health payments are spent even if the attack later misses. All Health costs leave at least 1 Health.
Card draw & recovery

Only one printed draw effect per player per active attack. Explicit draws may exceed 7. Recover only the specified Basic Reaction already played in this exchange; never recover a committed Attack or a prior exchange’s card.
Finish the round

Finish both attacks in the first pair, then reveal and resolve pair two. Keep unused cards. Draw up to 4, stopping at 7 in hand. No free discard. Refill an empty deck by shuffling your discard. Edge alternates.
Win

Reduce the rival to 0 Health. A lethal effect immediately resolves any pending already-active Helga reflection, then victory. Skip all remaining effects, including on-hit healing, Exploding Present self-loss and rewards. Lethal Loot also ends immediately. Simultaneous knockouts draw. At round 10 cleanup both lose 2 Health, then one more per later round, capped at 18.
Fury & Last Stand

Health damage and Health payments both count. The first time you survive at 10 Health or less, add your chosen Fury to hand; commit it in a future round. At 5 Health or less, finish the triggering card; if alive, activate Last Stand permanently. Healing does not remove either unlock. A lethal hit unlocks neither. Already-active Helga reflection resolves before victory.
Coins

Basic Attacks earn 1 Coin when they finish, even on a miss. Franc also gains 1 Profit on a damaging Basic Attack and may immediately cash 1 for 1 Coin. Reactions give no automatic income. Hold at most 8 Coins.
Arena

Join the two Heroes’ four-space boards to make a straight 8-space arena. Number the spaces 1–8. Start on 3 and 6. Only the outer ends (1 and 8) are walls. Crossing the join between 4 and 5 has no special effect. Pushing beyond an outer wall deals 1 wall damage, ignoring Block. Smasherton may add Crunch when eligible.
Loot draft & market

Each Hero chooses 6 different Loot from their 12-card pool. Shuffle both contributions into one shared 12-card deck. Reveal 3. Anyone can use any Loot. Between rounds, starting with the new Edge holder, each player may buy once: pay 2 Coins for a face-up Loot or a blind draw. Refill a bought slot immediately. Hold at most 2 Loot. Shuffle spent Loot when the draw pile empties; never shuffle held or face-up cards. Franc may first use Inside Deal once per shopping turn to buy a face-up item with 2 Profit, then take his normal Coin purchase if he has room.
Block
All unused Block clears after every attack, for everyone. Maximum 6 Block. Helga can break Armour for Block; she no longer receives free Block at enemy activation.
Hero tokens

Tokens replace the old passive abilities. They work from the start and persist between rounds. Follow the Hero board for earning and spending. A token reaction passes priority like a card. Activation choices happen before printed movement. Fury and Last Stand do not spend tokens.
Hit & modifiers

An attack connects if its current Range includes the rival. On hit requires at least 1 Health damage from that attack. Block prevents damage and is spent; ignored Block remains until cleanup, while removed Block is destroyed immediately. Damage, Range, piercing and other attack modifiers last only for the current attack. Loot damage is not an attack hit.
Attack cleanup

If no lethal effect ended the fight, resolve on-hit effects and each delayed per-card effect, then already-active Helga reflection and victory. If still fighting, settle pending Last Stands and attack-end token effects. Discard the finished attack. Clear both players’ unused Block and temporary attack modifiers before the next attack. Smasherton’s pin ends when the pinned fighter finishes their next attack.
Wall slam

A push beyond space 1 or 8 stops at the wall and deals 1 damage ignoring Block. Landing exactly on the wall deals no wall damage. One push effect causes at most one slam. Combine printed attack push and on-hit bonus push. Pulls never slam. Smasherton may spend Impact for Crunch only on an attack wall slam.
Draw limits

At most one printed draw effect per player per active attack, including attack activation and on-hit draws. Aim and Trick draws use that allowance. Shealer’s immediate Research draw after paying Health is a separate token reward, not a printed draw effect. Fury entering hand is also separate. Loot never counts against the seven-card refill limit.
Pin and swaps

Pin prevents voluntary Move, adjacent repositioning, token movement, Shadow swaps and ordinary swaps initiated by the pinned fighter. A blocked swap skips only the relocation; its other effects still resolve. A rival’s swap forcibly relocates a pinned target. Push and pull are forced movement and still work unless separately resisted. Swaps do not earn Raven Tricks.
Repeated delayed effects

Each Exploding Present played registers its own 1-Health loss after a damaging strike, unless an earlier lethal effect has ended the fight. Each Hold Your Ground registers its own Coin reward, capped by the shared 8-Coin limit. Any Health damage from the active attack, including its wall slam, prevents these rewards. Separate Loot damage does not.

builds.weakness: Wind needs setup and a movement effect. Minimum ranges matter; pins prevent voluntary movement.
